description: This file defines an enumeration GatewayEndpointID with static methods for handling network endpoint identifiers, including generating stable IDs and pretty descriptions for NWEndpoint objects.

methods.name: stableID
methods.description: Generates a stable string identifier for a given NWEndpoint, handling service endpoints specifically.

methods.name: prettyDescription
methods.description: Returns a human-readable description of the NWEndpoint, decoding any Bonjour escape sequences.

methods.name: normalizeServiceNameForID
methods.description: Normalizes service names by decoding escapes, removing whitespace, and trimming.
